title: Book 2 — Euterpe, Chapter 391
paragraphs: Amasis also dedicated in all the other important temples works worth seeing for their size, including at Memphis the colossal statue that lies on its back in front of the temple of Hephaistos, whose length is seventy-five feet. On the same base, made of the same stone, stand two colossal statues each twenty feet in length, one on each side of the large statue. There is also another stone statue of the same size at Saïs, lying in the same manner as the one at Memphis. Moreover, Amasis was the one who built and completed for Isis her temple at Memphis, which is of great size and very much worth seeing.
